name: Found a Wallet
description: You find a wallet on the street with $50 inside and an ID. What do you do?

choices.outcome: You contact the owner and return the wallet with everything still inside.

choices.text: Return it but keep the cash
choices.outcome: You remove the money before returning the wallet and hope no one notices.
You take the wallet home and make no attempt to find its owner.
You decide that the wallet is someone else’s responsibility.

name: Unexpected Bonus
description: Your employer surprises everyone with a small bonus at the end of the month.

name: Friend Calls Out of the Blue
description: Someone you lost touch with sends you a message out of the blue. How do you respond?

choices.outcome: You set aside your plans and enjoy a long conversation about old times.
You invite your old friend to meet you for a meal later in the week.
You exchange a few friendly words but end the call before it becomes lengthy.
You let the call go unanswered and do not return the message.

name: Minor Illness
description: You come down with a cold and spend a few days resting.

name: Community Event
description: Your neighbourhood is hosting a community clean-up day. Will you join?

choices.outcome: You volunteered and felt great about contributing. Reputation improved.
You stayed home but watched the event from your window.

name: Won a Small Prize
description: You entered a local contest months ago and have won a $200 gift card.

choices.outcome: You spend the gift card on something enjoyable that you would not normally buy.
You use your prize to surprise some of the important people in your life.
You find someone willing to buy the card from you for cash.
You put off collecting the prize until the claim period expires.

name: Lost Your Keys
description: You arrive home and realize that your keys are missing.

choices.outcome: You carefully revisit every place you went and eventually locate the keys.
You pay a professional to let you inside and replace the missing keys.
You attempt an awkward entrance and suffer a few scrapes along the way.
You remain outside until someone with a spare key can come to help.

name: Unexpected Tax Refund
description: A correction to an old tax return results in an unexpected $600 refund.

choices.outcome: You place the entire refund into your savings for a future need.
You use most of the refund to buy something you have wanted for a while.
You use the refund to reduce your debts and monthly obligations.
You spend the refund on training that could improve your career prospects.

name: Caught in a Rainstorm
description: A sudden downpour catches you several blocks from home without an umbrella.

choices.outcome: You sprint through the rain, but arrive home soaked and exhausted.
You embrace the moment and have fun despite getting completely drenched.
You find a covered doorway and calmly wait for the storm to pass.
You rush into a nearby shop and purchase protection from the weather.

name: Received a Surprise Gift
description: A package arrives from a friend containing a thoughtful gift you did not expect. The surprise reminds you that someone was thinking about you and brightens your entire day.

name: Found Money in an Old Coat
description: While cleaning out a closet, you discover $80 in the pocket of an old coat.

choices.outcome: You treat the discovery as an opportunity to strengthen your finances.
You spend the forgotten money on a meal, game, or other small luxury.
You decide that you did not miss the money and give it to someone who needs it.
You put the money back as a surprise for another day.

name: Minor Fender-Bender
description: You are involved in a low-speed collision. No one is seriously injured, but both vehicles are damaged.

choices.outcome: You check that everyone is safe and properly document the accident.
You offer to cover the damage without involving an insurance company.
You become argumentative and insist the other person caused everything.
You drive away before anyone can record your information.

name: Interesting Stranger
description: While waiting in a long line, you begin talking with a stranger who shares one of your hobbies.

choices.outcome: You decide that this could be the beginning of a new friendship.
You have a pleasant discussion but allow the encounter to end naturally.
You explain that you are not feeling social and return to waiting quietly.
You deliberately ignore the stranger until they stop trying to talk.

name: Broken Appliance
description: Your stove stops working without warning.

choices.outcome: You call a technician and pay to restore the appliance to working condition.
You replace it with a newer model that should be more reliable.
You study the problem and attempt to fix the appliance on your own, with uTube's help.
You reorganize your routine, buying more microwave meals, and postpone dealing with the problem.

name: Compliment from a Stranger
description: A stranger compliments your clothing and says you look great today. The unexpected compliment gives you a welcome boost of confidence.

name: New Favourite Restaurant
description: You try a recently opened restaurant and discover one of the best meals you have ever eaten.

choices.outcome: You extend the experience by ordering the restaurant’s most tempting dessert.
You tell several people about the restaurant and encourage them to try it.
You enjoy your meal and make a note to return when your budget allows.

name: Missed an Important Appointment
description: You lose track of time and miss an appointment that was difficult to schedule.

choices.outcome: You admit your mistake and ask for another appointment.
You create a story to avoid admitting that you simply forgot.
You take responsibility and use the experience as a lesson in planning.
You accuse another person of failing to remind you.

name: Neighbour Needs Help
description: Your neighbour asks for help moving a heavy piece of furniture.

choices.outcome: You spend part of your afternoon helping them move the furniture safely.
Afterward, you accept their invitation to relax and get to know them better.
You explain that you are busy and cannot help today.
You remain silent until your neighbour finally leaves.

name: Former Classmate Reconnects
description: A former classmate contacts you after finding an old school photograph.

choices.outcome: You exchange messages and happily revisit some shared memories.
You arrange an in-person reunion and talk about where life has taken you.
You read the message but decide that you do not want to reconnect.
You prevent the classmate from contacting you again without offering an explanation.

name: Found a Stray Animal
description: A frightened dog with a damaged identification tag follows you home.

choices.outcome: You post notices and contact nearby residents until the owner is located.
You take the animal somewhere equipped to care for it and find its owner.
You leave the animal outside and continue with your day.

name: Unusually High Utility Bill
description: Your utility bill is far higher than expected, placing pressure on your budget.

choices.outcome: You cover the entire charge and adjust the rest of your monthly spending.
You review your usage and successfully dispute part of the bill.
You arrange to divide the bill across several months.
You avoid the problem, allowing late fees and worry to accumulate.

name: Last-Minute Party Invitation
description: A friend invites you to a party tonight, but you had planned a quiet evening.

choices.outcome: You change your plans and spend an enjoyable evening socializing.
You buy something new and put extra effort into making a strong impression.
You politely decline and enjoy the peaceful evening you originally planned.
You ignore the invitation rather than telling your friend you cannot attend.

name: Package Delivered by Mistake
description: An expensive-looking package intended for someone several streets away is left at your door.

choices.outcome: You take the package to the correct address and introduce yourself.
You report the error and arrange for the package to be collected.
You leave the package untouched and hope the courier returns for it.
You remove the label and claim the package as your own.

name: Friend Announces an Engagement
description: A close friend announces that they are getting married and asks you to attend the celebration. You congratulate the couple, purchase a small gift, and join their celebration.

name: Small Inheritance
description: A distant relative has left you $2,500 in their will.

choices.outcome: You preserve the money as an emergency fund or future investment.
You use most of the inheritance for a memorable trip.
You spend the inheritance on courses and professional development.
You go on a shopping spree and quickly use almost all of the money.

name: Food Poisoning
description: After eating a questionable meal, you become ill and must spend the day recovering.

choices.outcome: You cancel your plans and give your body time to recover naturally.
You seek medical help and receive treatment for the worst symptoms.
You refuse to change your schedule, making your condition considerably worse.
You report the incident and receive a partial refund.

name: Forgotten Family Photograph
description: You discover an old family photograph tucked inside a rarely opened book. You spend some time remembering the people and events captured in the photograph.

name: Selected for Jury Duty
description: You receive an official notice requiring you to report for jury duty.

choices.outcome: You approach the responsibility seriously and learn about the justice system.
You follow the proper process to move your service to a better date.
You make questionable excuses in an attempt to escape the responsibility.
You become highly invested in understanding every detail presented.

name: Trip Cancelled
description: A trip you have been looking forward to is cancelled at the last moment.

choices.outcome: You recover the cost of the trip but lose the experience you anticipated.
You pay the additional fees and arrange to travel on another date.
You redirect part of the budget toward activities closer to home.
You cancel your vacation plans and use the unexpected free time to rest.

name: Free Event Tickets
description: A coworker gives you two free tickets to a concert or sporting event this weekend.

choices.outcome: You invite a friend and enjoy sharing the experience with them.
You use the tickets to create a special family memory.
You turn the unexpected gift into extra cash.
You pass the tickets to someone who would appreciate them more.

name: Witnessed an Accident
description: You witness an accident and appear to be the only person who clearly saw what happened.

choices.outcome: You assist the people involved until emergency services arrive.
You report the accident and provide the dispatcher with essential information.
You remain at the scene long enough to provide an accurate witness account.
You decide that becoming involved would be too inconvenient.

name: Locked Out of the House
description: The door closes behind you, leaving you outside without your keys or phone.

choices.outcome: You borrow their phone and wait somewhere comfortable while arranging help.
You damage the lock and injure yourself slightly while getting inside.
You sit outside until another person with a key arrives.
You find a creative but uncomfortable way to enter through an unlocked window.

name: Learned a New Skill
description: A casual conversation introduces you to a subject that could become a useful new skill.

choices.outcome: You develop a regular practice schedule and work toward mastering the skill.
You explore the subject casually without putting pressure on yourself.

choices.text: Turn it into a side job
choices.outcome: You use your developing ability to earn some additional income.
You experiment briefly but decide that the subject is not for you.

name: Handwritten Letter
description: You receive a thoughtful handwritten letter from someone important to you.

choices.outcome: You take the time to create an equally thoughtful response.
You phone them immediately and have a warm conversation.
You place it somewhere safe so that you can read it again in the future.
You intend to answer later, but the letter eventually slips your mind.

name: Local Celebrity Encounter
description: You unexpectedly meet a local celebrity while going about your day.

choices.outcome: You politely request a quick picture to remember the encounter.
You speak to them respectfully without drawing attention to their fame.
You obtain an autograph with the intention of selling it.
You recognize them but choose not to interrupt their day.

name: Treasured Possession Broken
description: While cleaning, you accidentally break an item with significant sentimental value.

choices.outcome: You hire a specialist to restore the item as well as possible.
You carefully study repair techniques and attempt the restoration personally.
You cannot repair the item, but you are not ready to let it go.
You decide that keeping the broken object will only make you feel worse.

name: Asked to Give a Presentation
description: You are unexpectedly asked to present an important topic in front of a large group.

choices.outcome: You spend significant time researching, rehearsing, and polishing your presentation.
You rely on your existing knowledge and speak without much preparation.
You avoid the uncomfortable task, even though others were counting on you.
You work with a colleague to create and deliver a stronger presentation.

name: Garage-Sale Bargain
description: At a garage sale, you discover a valuable collectible priced at only $10.

choices.outcome: You happily add the rare item to your personal collection.
You recognize its value and find a collector willing to pay much more.
You explain what the item is worth and give the owner a chance to reconsider.
You decide that you do not need another possession, even at an excellent price.

name: New Baby in the Family
description: A relative announces that they are expecting or adopting a child. You share in the family’s excitement and begin looking forward to meeting its newest member.

name: Conversation with a Coworker
description: A routine break turns into a surprisingly meaningful conversation with a coworker. You understand each other better and return to work feeling supported.

name: Discovered a Water Leak
description: You notice water pooling beneath a wall. A hidden pipe appears to be leaking.

choices.outcome: You hire a plumber to repair the leak before the damage spreads.
You purchase supplies and attempt a difficult repair after researching the problem.
A knowledgeable friend helps you repair the problem at a lower cost.
You postpone the repair until the leak causes substantial property damage.

name: Free Travel Upgrade
description: An airline unexpectedly upgrades you to a much more comfortable seat at no charge. You enjoy extra space, better service, and a far more relaxing journey.

name: Long-Awaited Apology
description: Someone who hurt you years ago contacts you with what appears to be a sincere apology.

choices.outcome: You forgive the person and allow yourself to let go of old resentment.
You have a difficult but honest conversation about the past.
You acknowledge the apology but explain that you are not ready to respond fully.
You tell the person that their apology has come too late.

name: Favourite Business Closes
description: A local shop or restaurant filled with good memories announces that it is closing permanently.

choices.outcome: You return for a final visit and say goodbye to the familiar staff.
You spend extra money to support the business during its final days.
You post a thoughtful message describing what the business meant to you.
You feel disappointed but decide not to visit before it closes.

name: Discovered a New Hobby
description: You try an unfamiliar activity on a whim and discover that you genuinely enjoy it.

choices.outcome: You invest in the basic supplies needed to pursue the hobby regularly.
You register for lessons so that you can develop proper techniques.
You meet other enthusiasts and make the hobby a social activity.
You enjoy the hobby occasionally without making a major commitment.

name: Power and Internet Outage
description: A neighbourhood outage leaves you without electricity or internet for most of the evening.

choices.outcome: You find a comfortable place and spend the evening reading by battery-powered light.
You use the interruption as an opportunity for conversation or games.
You visit a restaurant, theatre, or another place unaffected by the outage.
You focus on the inconvenience and allow it to ruin your night.

name: Rumour Spreading About You
description: You learn that an untrue and embarrassing rumour about you is circulating.

choices.outcome: You speak privately with the person responsible and firmly correct the story.
You make a public statement in an attempt to protect your reputation.
You refuse to give the rumour additional attention and wait for it to fade.
You retaliate by inventing an embarrassing story about the other person.

name: Recognition for Past Work
description: Work you completed years ago is rediscovered and praised by people who benefited from it. The recognition improves your professional standing and reminds you that your efforts mattered.

name: Mistaken for Someone Else
description: A stranger enthusiastically approaches you, convinced that you are someone they know.

choices.outcome: You gently explain the mistake without making the stranger feel foolish.
You respond as if you recognize them before revealing the amusing misunderstanding.
You continue the deception to see how long you can maintain it.
You leave without explaining why you are ignoring them.

name: Unexpected Day Off
description: A closure or scheduling error gives you an unplanned day away from work or school.

choices.outcome: You sleep late and give yourself permission to do very little.
You use the free time to complete tasks you have been postponing.
You spend the day enjoying an activity you normally do not have time for.
You devote the unexpected free time to study or deliberate practice.

name: Life-Changing Opportunity
description: You receive an opportunity in another city that could significantly change your career and personal life.

choices.outcome: You leave behind your familiar routine to pursue a demanding but lucrative future.
You propose taking the position without permanently leaving your current home.
You discuss the opportunity with the people who would be affected by your decision.
You choose stability and remain with your existing life.
